title: Hom. 11: Simeon’s Nunc dimittis (Luke 2:25-35)
english: Simeon waits for Israel’s consolation, takes the child, and sings [[now you dismiss your servant in peace >> Bible:Luke 2:29]]. The child is set for falling and rising; a sword will pierce Mary’s soul.
